footer.reportText: Report sites or vulnerabilities (read {link} before reporting):

kofiThanks.title: Thanks for your order
kofiThanks.lead: Check the email address you used at checkout. Your redeem link should arrive there shortly!
kofiThanks.instructions: Before opening the link, please make sure you are signed into eepy.page and that you are using the correct account. If you encounter any issues, don't hesitate to reach us at {emailLink}.

donate.title: Support eepy.page
donate.description: eepy.page is a free community service. We rely on donations to keep servers running and domains active.

modal.title: Cookies and privacy settings
modal.description: eepy.page uses cookies for login, security, storage, and site behavior. Some cookies are optional, and are used to enhance performance and provide analytics. You can manage your cookie preferences below.

preferences.title: Cookie preferences
preferences.necessaryDesc: Required for the proper operation of eepy.page. These cannot be disabled.
preferences.analyticsDesc: Analytics gather information such as page views, feature usage, and site performance, allowing us to improve our service where it is needed the most.
preferences.settingsDesc: You can change these settings at any time by clicking the cookie icon in the bottom left corner of the page.

cookies.eepyDesc: Authentication, state (login), abuse-prevention tokens, setting storage (cookie consent, theme, dismissed notices/prompts, other site behavior)
cookies.sentryDesc: Frontend error monitoring/logging, necessary for debugging and service reliability
cookies.gaDesc: Measures website usage and statistics as you interact with the site
cookies.speedInsightsDesc: Measures performance of the frontend site

hero.tagline: A modern, free subdomain service for everyone—whether you're a developer, hobbyist, or somewhere in between.

claim.title: Claim a piece of the internet
claim.descHighlight: Try out a domain you'd like to own!
claim.taken: Unfortunately, {domain} is already taken or invalid.

alwaysFree.title: Always free
alwaysFree.paragraph1: eepy.page will always be completely free for anyone to use.
alwaysFree.paragraph2: Our goal is to provide a reliable, convenient service to anyone, which means that regardless of whether you own a domain or not, you are more than welcome to use our service!
alwaysFree.graphicText2: So why not give it a try?

servicesSupport.title: Support for many services
servicesSupport.lead: Since you have full control over DNS records, most services that simply require a domain are supported!
servicesSupport.andMore: ...and more! Services that only require a standard DNS record and a subdomain-scoped TXT record will work.

management.title: Independent domain management
management.paragraph1: You can register, delete, and modify domains straight from our dashboard, designed to be convenient and user-friendly.
management.paragraph2: There is no need to use a convoluted CLI or a request form, and you don't have to wait for any domain verification.
management.paragraph3: Subdomain registrations are seamlessly added to our database and DNS servers the second you register them.

tunneling.title: Robust tunneling
tunneling.paragraph1: No port forwarding? No public IP? Fear not, eepy.page provides a seamless tunneling experience, allowing you to forward your local services to the internet!
tunneling.paragraph2: Our tunneling service is powered by Serveo. Simply visit our simple dashboard for easy instructions on attaching your local services to an eepy.page subdomain.

openSource.title: Completely open-source
openSource.paragraph1: Our frontend and backend are both completely open-source, and we are always open to contributions. Our backend is written in Python (FastAPI), and our frontend uses SvelteKit.
openSource.paragraph2: The authoritative nameservers running our infrastructure are powered by PowerDNS, which is also open-source.
